booking.title: Let's Make It Official 📅
booking.subtitle: Choose the format that works for you — every option comes with the same personalised attention that's earned me a 5.0 rating across 3,500+ lessons.
booking.reassurance: Not sure which to pick? The Trial Lesson is the perfect no-pressure place to start. I'd love to meet you! 🌸

booking.trustLine: Trusted by 500+ students | 3,500+ lessons completed | Perfect 5.0 rating | 100% attendance rate

step1.title: We talk about your goals
step1.description: Every first lesson starts with you. Where are you now? Where do you want to go? What do you actually enjoy?

step2.title: I build a plan around your life
step2.description: No generic textbooks. Your lessons are shaped around your schedule, your interests, and the way you learn best.

step3.title: Every lesson feels like a conversation
step3.description: Not a lecture. Not a drill session. A real, engaging hour that leaves you feeling like you actually got somewhere.

trial.name: Trial Lesson
trial.description: Your first step into a whole new language world. This relaxed 30-minute session is about getting to know each other — I'll learn about your goals, your background, and how you learn best. You'll leave with a clear, personalised learning plan and (hopefully!) a lot of excitement about what's ahead. Over 500 students have started exactly here.
features: We figure out how you learn best
You leave with a clear, personalised plan

standard.name: Standard Lesson
standard.description: This is where the magic happens — and where most of my 3,500+ lessons have taken place. A full 60-minute immersive session tailored entirely to you. We'll work through conversation, grammar, vocabulary, and cultural context in a way that feels natural, not forced. You'll get homework that actually helps (I promise), regular progress check-ins, and you can message me between lessons anytime. This is the package my students keep coming back to, week after week.

intensive.name: Intensive Pack
intensive.description: For students who are serious about making fast, visible progress. Five dedicated 60-minute sessions with a curriculum built entirely around your goals — whether that's preparing for a trip, getting work-ready, or reaching the next level. You get priority booking (you always come first), unlimited messaging between sessions, and all learning materials included. This is the closest thing to having a personal language coach on call.
features: A curriculum built entirely around you
All learning materials included — no extras needed
